newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds rebound to close firmer.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds rebound to close firmer.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Dutch bonds rebounded with bunds in late trade, recapturing much of their early gains. Dealers say 10-year yields, already at 30-year lows could fall to 5.00/5.25 pct. * Sept 2001 117.80/90, bid yld 4.37 pct vs 117.80/90, 4.37.
Yield spread vs Sept 2001 bund -0.07 basis points. * Feb 2007 102.26/34, bid yield 5.45 pct vs 102.05/15, 5.47.
Yield spread vs Jan 2007 bund steady at -11 basis points. * Dutch Feb 2007 yields 110 basis points over Dutch Sept 2001.
